pr_body:
This commit comprehensively refactors the cumulative test definitions for the declarative schema changer.

Fixes #106920.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/106743)

Thanks for the review! There's still one outstanding issue to resolve in this PR in that the `schemachangerccl` now has an unholy amount of tests and the CI times out. I got rid of the randomized skipping because I didn't like it. I'd much rather we deliberately skip entire classes of checks in regular CI and skip nothing during the nightlies. For instance, in the backup tests, skip everything except RESTORE DATABASE cases for successful schema changes in non-mixed clusters. I'm not sure how to do this properly. (edit: is skip.UnderShort() all it takes? that's nice if it's the case)

> Can we clean this up now?

I hadn't even looked into this. Presumably! I'll give it a whirl.

I'm battling the `maybe_stress` portion of the CI. See https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/CJ0H8Q97C/p1690203313338359 for details.

@fqazi also I renamed the `TestValidateMixedVersionElements` to `TestPauseMixedVersion` because from what I can tell it's a mixed-version flavour of `TestPause`.

> @fqazi also I renamed the `TestValidateMixedVersionElements` to `TestPauseMixedVersion` because from what I can tell it's a mixed-version flavour of `TestPause`.
That sounds good, and its a less verbose description.

I think that's a good approach and I'm guessing local builds also run everything too

issue_context.title: schemachanger,sctest: backup tests are slightly broken
issue_context.body:
In an effort to understand how the `TestBackup*` cumulative tests for the declarative schema changer work, I noticed a subtle bug: we back up _after_ executing each post-commit stage, which is fine but means we never test backups after the stmt txn commits but before the job runs, which is arguably the most important case.

~As it turns out, fixing this reveals other longstanding bugs.~

This issue tracks the need to refactor the `sctest` framework, especially the backups tests.

Jira issue: CRDB-29767
comments: I've made decent progress in this and have reached a point where I'm fixing longstanding bugs that were surfaced as a result.

~Updated the issue description because at this point I think that there is one real longstanding bug, and I can't get to the bottom of it right now. I tracked it in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/107269~

review_comments: `TestServerFactory` and its vanilla and multi-region implementations replace the old `newClusterFunc`.
